dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、今日で授業は終わり。明日からは卒
　業パーティーの準備期間だから登校は自由に
　なるが、明日だけはちゃんと来るんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"This ends the classes for this semester. Those with
graduation party commitments, please don't forget to come to
school."
dialogues.text:
"This ends the classes for this semester. Those with
graduation party commitments, please don't forget to come to
school."

dialogues.jp:
これで事実上、休みに入ったも同然。明日の朝
は出欠をとるだけで終わり。卒パに出店・出席
する連中はそうじゃないけど
dialogues.en:
From here on, it's as good as vacation. Tomorrow, attendance
won't be taken in the morning anymore, and I'm not joining
events.
dialogues.text:
From here on, it's as good as vacation. Tomorrow, attendance
won't be taken in the morning anymore, and I'm not joining
events.

dialogues.jp: （まあ、俺には今のところ関係ない）
dialogues.en: "(Well, even so, it'd have nothing to do with me.)"
dialogues.text: "(Well, even so, it'd have nothing to do with me.)"

dialogues.jp: さてと……これからどうしようか。
dialogues.en: Now then... what should I do.
dialogues.text: Now then... what should I do.

dialogues.jp:
よっしゃ、とうとう終った。付属最後の授業。
どうせ、明日の登校は朝出席を取るだけだし、
卒パの関係ない俺は、特に残る必要もないし。
dialogues.en:
It's finally over, all the classes. Tomorrow attendance
won't be taken, and I have nothing to do regarding the
graduation party, so there's no reason for me to be here
again.
dialogues.text:
It's finally over, all the classes. Tomorrow attendance
won't be taken, and I have nothing to do regarding the
graduation party, so there's no reason for me to be here
again.

dialogues.jp: さて、これからどうするかな。
dialogues.en: Now then, what should I do.
dialogues.text: Now then, what should I do.
